name: restore_original_document
description: Replace the working file with the exact captured original, verified by SHA-256, and record a new history commit. Requires sessionId. Unsaved edits refuse unless discard:true explicitly discards them. Refuses an externally changed file or history that does not match the saved state. Close other programs editing this file before restoring; an external write racing the final replacement cannot be excluded. Reloads the session under its opening policy. Normal revert/redo restore document state, not necessarily the original ZIP bytes. The next normal save may normalize the file again. Use export_original_document for recovery to a different path.
